violations.description: Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager had an expired certificate or is no longer associated with this establishment. Both people on the license are no longer associated with the establishment. Could not verify if another individual was a certified food service manager.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. The paper towel dispenser for the front hand sink was empty.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. A box of clear lids was stored on the floor under the hand sink in the kitchen.
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
Clean, employee dressing area, cleaning equipment storage, living/sleeping quarters separate (1 pt deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
